## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION: PASS** (task 0). No affected documents. First revision; no prior revision to relate to.

Policy-side notes (recorded, do not change this verdict):
1. Term change overwrite retires the whole base clause "A move to a lower plan, or from the annual to the monthly term, takes effect at the plan's downgrade effective point." while its replaced_by restates the annual→monthly half with the same timing; the lower-plan half then survives only as the tier parameter ("Move to a lower plan or cheaper term takes effect: Next billing date"). Nature: overwrite that retires and restates the same semantics. The KB renders both faithfully (retired in `plan_change_terms_bc9cf9f1`, restated in the hub).
2. Cancellation overwrite retires base "credited in full" / "with no administration fee." while the cancellation baseline restates "credited in full, with no administration fee withheld", and the schedule figure "Refund administration fee waived when the order is cancelled before shipment: Yes" (cancellation_credit_admin_fee_waived) remains alongside the new cancellation administration fee. Nature: same-semantics retire-and-restate; KB faithful.
3. After the dispute overwrite, an upheld dispute on any ground other than a missing standing discount has no credit-sizing clause in force. Outside both tasks; the KB invents none.
4. The FVF discount clause is retired from billing, while "a standing discount not applied although the standing level and handling time qualified" remains a live uphold ground. Nature: source design choice; KB faithful.
